{{Quote|I have a quick job for you friend. I'm an architect and could use someone of your skill to clear some unwelcome inhabitants off of some land I just recently purchased. Does this sound like something you could help me with?|Kant Graf, to a Force-sensitive spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
'''Kant Graf''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Architect/Legends|architect]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Graf sought to begin construction on an area of land occupied by a family of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. However, the Gungans refused to clear the area, losing Graf [[Currency/Legends|money]] for every [[Standard day/Legends|day]] he failed to begin construction. With the help of a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who was undergoing [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], Graf hoped that the Gungans could be convinced to move out. However, after the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] learned that the Gungans had lived on the land for a very long time, the Force-sensitive decided to let the Gungans keep the land, much to Kant Graf's dismay.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Yesa, howsa can wesa helps you?''"<br />"''You are trespassing on my client's land.''"<br />"''Trespassing? Wesa lived here for evers. Yousa are the ones trespassing.''"<br />"''If that is true, why was this land up for sale?''"<br />"''Wesa don't know anythings abouts no sales. I apologize for intruding and upsetting you.''"<br />"''Yousa tells yousa client dat mesa lands not for sells and to leaves mesa alone.|A Gungan landowner and a Force-sensitive spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] by the name of Kant Graf lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a major conflict between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Graf worked as an [[Architect/Legends|architect]].<ref name="SWG" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he sought to begin construction on a piece of land inhabited by a family of [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]]. However, the Gungans refused to move off the land, which ended up costing Graf [[Currency/Legends|money]] for every [[Standard day/Legends|day]] construction failed to commence.<ref name="SWG" />
{{GameLS|Star Wars Galaxies}}
Fortunately for Graf, he was approached by a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] undergoing a series of [[Jedi Trials/Legends|Jedi Trials]]. As part of their [[Jedi training/Legends|training]], the [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] traveled [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] in search of citizens facing difficult situations. After hearing Graf's plight, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi-to-be]] agreed to deal with the Gungans. Initially, the Padawan accused one of the Gungan inhabitants of trespassing on their client's land. However, the intrepid Force-sensitive soon learned that the family of Gungans had actually lived there for a very long time, and that the land was never put up for sale. The Padawan apologized for inconveniencing the Gungan landowner, and returned to Graf to inform him that he had no right to take the land away from them. Graf was left incredulous by the Padawan's "sickening" display of sympathy, and insisted that the land was rightfully his, despite the fact that the Gungans were occupying it.<ref name="SWG" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Is the area cleared?"<br />"That land already has an owner. You have no right to take it from them."<br />"An owner?! That family may occupy that land, but I am it's owner. Your sympathy is sickening.|Kant Graf and a Force-sensitive spacer|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Kant Graf had [[Color/Legends|red]] skin, and yellow-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. Greedy and unsympathetic, Graf proved willing to evict a family of Gungans from an area of land which he believed was rightfully his, even if it meant using [[Death/Legends|deadly]] force. Although he ordinarily acted friendly and respectful, Graf was liable to exhibit a more vicious demeanor if he did not get his way. When the Force-sensitive spacer employed by Graf refused to take the land away from the Gungans, he was sickened by the Padawan's sympathetic display, and lashed out emotionally.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==

During his time as an architect, Graf wore all black [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], including a [[Leather/Legends|leather]] trim [[shirt]] beneath a thick, wooly [[Jacket/Legends|jacket]], and dress slacks along with a pair of high quality [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Is the area cleared?"<br />"Yes, it is. I'm proud to say that the gungan ''[sic]'' claiming to own the land is dead."<br />"I'm glad to hear that, construction can now begin. Thank you for your hard work.|Dialogue with Kant Graf, if the player chose to kill the Gungan landowner|<ref name="SWG" />}}
Kant Graf was a non-player character in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> He was added to the game on [[August 31]], [[2004]] as part of [[W:c:swg:Publish 10 Notes for 31 August 04|Publish 10]], which revamped the process for becoming a [[W:c:swg:Jedi (pre-NGE)|Jedi]] in the form of newly implemented [[W:c:swg:Padawan Trials|Padawan Trial]] [[W:c:swg:Quest|quests]].<ref name="Publish">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64187&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2004}}</ref> Graf was involved in one of the sixteen trial quests that players could complete, which required the player to resolve a land dispute with a [[W:c:swg:Gungan|Gungan]] NPC. Players would need to complete eight of these sixteen trial quests successfully in order to qualify as a [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi Initiate]]. Because the trial quests were randomly assigned, it was possible for players to not be assigned Graf's quest. It was also possible for players to refuse the quest, or to fail up to three of the trials before being forced to restart the entire process over again. In this case, it was possible for players to fail the quest by wrongfully killing the Gungan landowner, instead of allowing the Gungan to keep the land. However, this article assumes 100% game completion under the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light sided]] character choices. Each of the trial quests had a core moral that needed to be applied. In Graf's quest, the moral was, "A Jedi must gather all possible information before making a decision."<ref name="SWG" /> With the release of [[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15 2005|Publish 25's]] [[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]] on [[November 15]], [[2005]], the [[W:c:swg:Jedi|Jedi]] [[W:c:swg:Profession|profession]] was once again revamped, this time to simply become a starter profession.<ref name="NGE">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> The Padawan Trial quests were rendered defunct as a result, effectively removing Kant Graf from the game.<ref name="SWG" />
